name: SC-001: Products Page Loads and Displays Catalog
objective: Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/products and verify the text All Products is visible.

name: SC-002: Add Product to Cart Shows Confirmation
objective: Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/products, click the Add to cart button for Blue Top, and verify the text Added! is visible.

name: SC-003: View Product Opens Detail Page
objective: Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/products, click the View Product link for Blue Top, and verify the text Write Your Review is visible.

name: SC-004: Cart Page Is Accessible
objective: Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/view_cart and verify the text Shopping Cart is visible.

name: SC-005: Login Page Displays Login Form
objective: Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/login and verify the text Login to your account is visible.
